Butcher.Description: Strong, heals quickly, has the stamina of a much younger man. Fearless in battle, what lesser men mistake for anger and rashness.

Hunter.Description: A cunning fighter with a steady hand no ego. The miission is the only thing that matters, everything else is a mere distraction

Slayer.Description: Finds twisted delight in wielding witchcraft to dispatch the witch-made abominations. Agile, witch a talent for close-range combat.

Shadow.Description: Respects witch magic enough to avoid unnecessary risks. Why slit  throats when a bullet from the shadows achieves the same end?

Saint.Description: An avid student of the Fates. For as Publilius Syrus noted, against a lucky man even gods are powerless.

Penitent.Description: A haunted man, cursed by his past and oblivious to the shadows looming in his future. WARNING: Not recommended for beginners.
